# The test-feature canary fixture. scripts/test-feature-canary-selftest.sh
# copies this file as Cargo.toml, and lib.rs.txt as src/lib.rs, into a
# scratch directory outside the repository and builds the crate there; the
# files keep a .txt suffix so no tool here takes them for a workspace crate.
# scripts/test_published_crates_standalone.py holds the canary to the shape
# the Core crates' lib.rs files must have.

[features]

[package.metadata.meerkat.standalone-tests]
